response.rationale: The champion and runner-up candidates both suggest a diagnosis of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, but the champion has more comprehensive support from the pathology report, including the presence of large atypical lymphoid cells, marked nuclear pleomorphism, and vascular involvement.

rejected.why: The runner-up candidate, although similar to the champion, is considered an append-only completion and does not provide sufficient distinct evidence to surpass the champion.
